item.summary: Crypto portfolio and tax service Kryptos has launched a ChatGPT plugin that lets users ask about portfolio value, cost basis, gains and tax figures, with answers drawn from the wallets and exchanges they have connected. According to Kryptos, the plugin cannot trade, transfer or withdraw assets, and using it requires a paid Kryptos plan.
